overall_notes: The paper presents HaluEval benchmark for evaluating LLM hallucination recognition. It uses both automatic metrics (Accuracy, BERTScore) and human evaluation. LLMs (primarily ChatGPT) are used as judges to classify hallucination presence. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of generation models from the LLM-as-judge question.
